Status: ✅ Production-ready session recording and memory system
### Overview
AI Observer automatically records Q CLI sessions, extracts key information using AI analysis, and stores it in mempalace for permanent cross-session
memory. You've recorded 61 sessions with 100% reliability after April 24 fixes.
### Core Architecture
./q-observed (wrapper)
↓
asciinema records session → .cast file
↓
Python parses (removes UI noise, ANSI codes)
↓
Q CLI analyzes → structured JSON
↓
SSH to mempalace (192.168.1.137)
↓
Storage:
├─ Drawer: ai-observer/sessions (full JSON)
└─ Knowledge Graph: facts (worked_on, completed_task)
### Key Components
1. Main Recording Script (q-observed)
• Wraps q chat with asciinema recording
• Intelligent parsing: filters spinners, banners, tool output
• AI analysis via Q CLI (extracts summary, tasks, decisions, commands, files, tech)
• JSON extraction with ANSI stripping + balanced brace tracking
• Direct SSH storage to mempalace
• Fallback handling + local persistence
• Emergency backup on failure
2. Search & Analytics
• search-sessions - Quick list of all stored sessions
• stats.sh - Analytics dashboard (sessions/day, top tech, trends)
• Knowledge graph queries via Q
3. Installation & Setup
• install.sh - One-command setup (checks deps, configures SSH, creates alias)
• config.env - Centralized configuration (server IP, username)
• setup-backup-cron.sh - Automated daily backups at 11:59 PM
4. Backup System
• backup/backup-cast.sh - Single file emergency backup
• backup/backup-today.sh - Batch backup all today's sessions
• Auto-triggered on storage failure
• Stores raw .cast files in ai-observer/backup-casts
5. Migration & Recovery
• migrate-mempalace.sh - Server migration tool
• backfill-sessions.sh - Recover specific missing sessions
• sync-missing-sessions.sh - Interactive sync tool
### Data Flow
Session Recording:
1. User runs ./q-observed (or alias q)
2. asciinema captures everything → session-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.cast
3. Python parses .cast file, removes noise
4. Q CLI analyzes content → JSON with structured data
5. Python extracts valid JSON (handles ANSI codes)
6. SSH to mempalace server
7. Python stores drawer + adds KG facts
8. Success message with replay instructions
Retrieval:
• Ask Q: "What did I work on today?"
• Run ./search-sessions for quick list
• Run ./stats.sh for analytics
• Replay: asciinema play session-*.cast
### Statistics (as of April 24, 2026)
• **61 total sessions** recorded locally
• **54 sessions** mentioned in docs (21 in mempalace)
• **59+ facts** in knowledge graph
• **100% reliability** after fixes
• **Date range**: April 17-24, 2026
• **Peak day**: April 23 (16 sessions)
• **Top tech**: mempalace (16), SSH (13), bash (8), EKS (7), Kubernetes (6)

### Technical Highlights
Intelligent Parsing:
• Captures only meaningful conversation (starts at > prompt)
• Handles malformed JSON with fallback
Reliable Storage:
• SSH connection reuse (ControlMaster/ControlPersist)
• Duplicate detection in mempalace
• Local persistence before remote storage
• Emergency backup on failure
• Validation at every step
Knowledge Graph Integration:
• prathammodi → worked_on → [summary]
• prathammodi → completed_task → [task] (up to 3 per session)
• Temporal validity (valid_from date)
• Queryable across sessions

./q-observed  # or just 'q' if alias installed
